start: Joined gym has set its hours in the admin app; Gym tab, Tuesday 7 pm IST

user_sees: Row 'Open now · closes 10:00 pm' with a clock icon, and a special day this week under it such as 'Closed Sun 8 Nov · Diwali'
must_not: The row in the phone's own time zone instead of India time
'Open now' while the gym's hours say closed

user_sees: Screen 'Gym timings'
'Open now · closes 10:00 pm'
'<gym> · India time'
The gym's note, such as 'Ladies batch 11 am to 12 pm'
must_not: 'No timings yet' for a gym that has set hours

user_sees: Monday to Sunday, today marked 'Today' in the gym colour
'Closed' days in grey
This week's special days under their day
must_not: Today marked on the wrong day
A special day of next week put into this week

user_sees: The special days coming up in plain words
must_not: A past special day still listed

start: Gym timings screen open, the gym has just changed its hours in the admin app

user_sees: The new hours at once
must_not: The old hours kept for 10 minutes after a pull

user_sees: The Gym tab with the row showing the new hours
must_not: The app closing (Back goes to the Gym tab)

start: Joined gym has never set its hours

user_sees: No hours row at all
must_not: An empty row or 'Closed now' for a gym with no hours

user_sees: 'No timings yet'
'<gym> hasn't added its opening times in MettleUp yet. Ask at the desk.'
must_not: An endless 'Loading…'

start: Phone not joined to any gym opens the timings link

user_sees: The Gym tab's not-joined screen (GymOnly)
must_not: Another gym's hours
A crash

start: Gym timings screen open at 9:59 pm, gym closes at 10:00 pm

steps.action: Keep the screen open past 10 pm
user_sees: Within 30 seconds 'Closed now · opens 5:00 am tomorrow'
must_not: 'Open now' kept after closing time

steps.action: Turn the internet off, close and reopen the app, open Gym timings
user_sees: The kept copy at once
must_not: 'No timings yet' offline after the first answer

user_sees: Only the gym's own hours, note and special days
must_not: Another branch's or gym's hours
Staff names or member data
